title: Hello World — Why I Started Writing
subtitle: A short first post to test the publishing pipeline, block by block.
author: Iftekharul Abedeen

blocks.text: Welcome to my little corner of the web. This first post exists mostly to prove the plumbing works: every article on this site is a plain JSON file, and each element you see — this paragraph, the images below, the quote, the code — is a *block* rendered by the site. It supports **bold text**, *italics*, `inline code`, and [links](https://github.com/abedeen25).

Teaching forces you to explain things clearly; research forces you to defend them. Writing in public does both at once. I plan to write about human-computer interaction, applied machine learning, the occasional 3D render breakdown, and whatever I learn while teaching.

blocks.alt: Stylized 3D scene inspired by Spirited Away
blocks.caption: A render study — images support captions and lazy-load as you scroll.

blocks.text: If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.
That's the whole toolbox for now. If you're reading this, the pipeline works — see you in the next post.
